accueil.introduction: Plan, perform, report and validate every visit, in every country.
accueil.semaineTexte: Plan preparation arrives in version 0.2.1, visits in 0.4.1.

oubli.explication: Enter your username or email. If an account matches, you will receive a link valid for 30 minutes.
oubli.envoye: If an account matches, a link has just been sent. Remember to check your spam folder.

reinitialisation.explication: At least 12 characters, not too common, not close to your name, and without a compromising word (company, business, country or city name).
reinitialisation.differents: The two passwords do not match.
reinitialisation.succes: Password saved. You can now sign in.
reinitialisation.lienManquant: Incomplete link: open the link you received by email.

session.expiree: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

erreurs.reseau: Service unreachable. Check your connection and try again.
erreurs.texte: The error was reported to the technical team. Reload the page; if it happens again, give the reference below to support.
erreurs.horsLigne: You are offline. The information shown may be out of date.
erreurs.introuvableTexte: This address does not match any page, or you do not have access to it.

marque.accroche: Field activity of medical representatives, planned, proven and validated.

atouts.planifier: Plan the week and get it approved
atouts.visiter: Visit, even offline, with GPS proof
atouts.valider: Validate reports in a few clicks

mobile.sousTitreConnexion: Sign in to find your round.
mobile.prochainement: Your round and visits arrive in the next versions.

aVenir.semaine: Prepare your week from your target list and follow its approval.
aVenir.prospects: Find your prospects, even offline, and suggest new ones.
aVenir.chiffres: Track your visits, coverage and targets.

mobile.telephoneAide: Registered at sign-in; your country administrator can revoke it if it is lost.
mobile.doubleAuthPortail: Your role requires two-step verification. Turn it on from the web portal (My profile), then sign in here again.

verrou.texte: For security, the app locks after 5 minutes in the background.
verrou.sansProtection: This phone has no passcode or biometrics: sign in again.

roles.aucun: No role is assigned to you in this country. Contact your country administrator.

monPoste.aucun: No position is assigned to you in this country.
monPoste.superviseurManquant: Your main position has no supervisor: you will not be able to submit a plan. Let your country administrator know.

organisation.lectureSeule: Read only: only the country administrator and headquarters change the organisation.
organisation.choisirPays: Choose a country to change its organisation.

filtres.recherche: Search a position, a person, a sector

aides.affecter: Representatives and supervisors of the country. A position has one holder at a time.
aides.rattacher: The previous reporting line ends on this date; the past does not change.
aides.liberer: {{personne}}'s occupancy ends today; the history is kept.

vides.postesTexte: Create the representatives' positions: a position can be vacant and cover several sectors.
vides.zonesTexte: A zone groups sectors; a sector belongs to a single zone.
vides.reseauxTexte: A division groups networks; the product portfolio arrives in version 0.1.1.

profilPage.langueAide: Your choice follows you on the portal and on your phone.
profilPage.change: Password changed. Your other sessions were closed.

equipe.nouveauCompteAide: A link valid for 30 minutes is sent to choose the password. Username in the firstname.lastname format.

fiche.transfertAide: The main country changes; roles, positions and reporting lines end in the former country, where the history stays.
fiche.doubleAuthReinitialisee: Two-step verification reset: it will be set up again at next sign-in.

appareils.confirmer: {{personne}} will no longer be able to sign in or sync from this phone. Continue?
appareils.videTexte: A phone registers on its first sign-in to the mobile app.
appareils.contactAide: Last exchange with the server; data sync arrives in version 0.8.1.

parametres.sousTitre: Country rules · {{pays}}. A change applies from now on, never to the past.
parametres.choisirPays: Choose a country to see its settings.

cles.seuils_visites_jour: Visits per day by position type
cles.visites_sans_gps_tolerees: Visits without GPS allowed per day
cles.delai_escalade_heures_ouvrees: Delay before escalation to the DM (working hours)

paysPage.sousTitre: Subsidiaries and their status. Only the headquarters administrator changes them.
paysPage.codeAide: Code of a subsidiary in the catalogue (e.g. CI, BJ, ML).
paysPage.confirmerSuspension: Users in {{pays}} will no longer be able to sign in (headquarters keeps access).
paysPage.confirmerArchivage: {{pays}} will become read-only for headquarters. This change is final.

exploitation.sousTitre: Technical state of the service: database, country isolation, error tracking.
exploitation.roleContourne: The database role bypasses isolation: fix before going live.
exploitation.suiviInactif: Logs only: add SENTRY_DSN to be alerted.
exploitation.auditImmuable: Immutable: the database refuses any change.

code.explication: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
code.explicationSecours: Enter one of the backup codes saved when you turned it on.

doubleAuth.description: A one-time code shown by an app on your phone protects your account even if your password is stolen.
doubleAuth.requiseTexte: Your role gives access to sensitive data: two-step verification is required before you continue. It takes two minutes.
doubleAuth.installerTexte: Install a free authenticator app on your phone: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or an equivalent app.
doubleAuth.scannerTexte: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code.
doubleAuth.confirmerTexte: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now.
doubleAuth.codesTexte: Keep these codes somewhere safe, away from your phone. Each one replaces the app code once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
doubleAuth.notes: I have stored my codes safely
doubleAuth.qrAlt: QR code to scan with the authenticator app

apparence.aide: “System” follows your computer setting. This choice is remembered on this browser.

demonstration.texte: Fictitious data: no real people or institutions.

referentiel.sousTitre: Products, network portfolios and value lists · {{pays}}.
referentiel.sousTitreConsolide: Products and value lists across all countries.
referentiel.choisirPays: Choose a country to edit its reference data.
referentiel.lectureSeule: Read only: the country administrator maintains reference data.

produit.codeAide: Left empty, it is derived from the name.
produit.reseauxAide: A product can belong to several networks.
produit.videTexte: Add the laboratory's products, then place them in the network portfolios.

portefeuille.aide: Ticked products are offered to this network's reps from today; past reports keep theirs.
portefeuille.videTexte: No products: this network's reps will have nothing to present.
portefeuille.aucunReseauTexte: First create divisions and networks in Organisation.

aides.type_prospect: Doctor, pharmacist, midwife… Each prospect record has one.
aides.specialite: Link a specialty to a prospect type to offer it only for that type.
aides.type_etablissement: Practice, hospital, pharmacy… Each institution has one.
aides.motif_ecart: Reasons a rep picks when a planned visit does not take place.

valeur.archiverAide: Nothing is deleted: an archived value is no longer offered but stays readable where it was used.

mesProduits.texte: Your networks' portfolio, offered in your visit reports.
mesProduits.vide: No products in your networks' portfolio.
